note: Through 2025, the last full year in the records. Madison Square Garden's exemption for fiscal 1984-2023 is read from the bars of the Independent Budget Office's chart and scaled to its stated total; fiscal 2024 and 2025 are the Department of Finance's values. The United Center's formula is counted in the year each tax bill was paid. Repairs and renovation money are counted by project, not by year, and are not included.
method: select year, team, kind, description, public_2026_m from after_items where kind in ('ongoing', 'break') and year <= 2025 order by year, team, description
